name: PalPanelServerMods
description: Server-only Community-Raid build. Stable raid runtime, native wild-controller combat and the authoritative 6000-unit arena remain enabled. The visible boundary now uses proven replicated NPC carriers only as hidden transport anchors, permanently neutralizes them, and renders the actual boundary through Palworld's vanilla UPalVisualEffectComponent using FadeOut plus FireCondition. No visible Pal marker ring, PalNetworkTransmitter, direct Lua NetMulticast, BuildObject walls, SkillEffect barriers or client installation is required.
